title: Case: Potted plants delivered in crushed boxes with soil spilled
context: Three potted plants from Ashgrove Goods arrived in crushed cartons. The merchant's Damage intake team records transit damage and decides anything that follows from it.
initial_request: Got the email from Ashgrove, thank you, that's all I wanted really. I've repotted the one that tipped over and they look alright, a bit sulky. No need to do anything else, I'll write to them myself if one dies on me. The cardboard really was flimsy though!

events.body: Hello. My plants came this morning (order TG-8316, two olive trees and a fern). Both boxes were crushed in on one side and there's soil all through the bottom, one pot was lying on its side. Bit of a mess on the hall floor to be honest. I think the plants themselves are fine, a couple of bent fronds on the fern. I don't want to send them back. Just thought someone ought to know the boxes aren't up to it.
Route plan for depot CT-5 published for Thursday. 24 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
My parcel DL-16347 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

DL-5568 / order TG-8316, three potted plants delivered this morning. The recipient, Gideon Pilkington, reports both cartons crushed on one side, soil spilled and one pot tipped over. She believes the plants are intact and is not asking for a return or a replacement. Please record it and tell her directly whether you need anything from her.

Thank you for telling us. I have passed your report to Damage intake at Ashgrove Goods, who record transit damage and decide anything further. That decision is theirs and not mine. They will contact you directly.
My parcel DL-36104 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

events.to: Gideon Pilkington, recipient; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Dear Ms Pilkington, thank you, this is logged as packaging report PK-3228. No return is needed and we need nothing further from you. Live plants are covered for 14 days from delivery: if any of the three declines before 14 June, reply to this email with a photo and we will look at it then. We have passed the box condition to our warehouse and to the carrier.

events.to: Dispatch, Calloway Arc Logistics; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: For your records: DL-5568 arrived with both cartons crushed on one side, see our packaging report PK-3228. No claim is raised at this time.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.

Got the email from Ashgrove, thank you, that's all I wanted really. I've repotted the one that tipped over and they look alright, a bit sulky. No need to do anything else, I'll write to them myself if one dies on me. The cardboard really was flimsy though!

must: Takes no action and sends no message to anyone.
Records why: Damage intake has logged the report as PK-3228 and told the carrier, and Gideon has acknowledged their reply and says nothing else is needed.
Notes that if a plant declines before 14 June the route is hers to use directly with Damage intake, so there is nothing for the desk to follow up.
must_not: Asks Replacement authorisations or any other team for replacement plants, or opens a damage claim with the merchant or the carrier.
Sends Damage intake or Dispatch another message about the crushed cartons, which are already logged and passed on.
Asks Gideon for photos or further details that Damage intake has said it does not need.
Tells Gideon the plants are fine or will recover, or offers a refund, replacement or compensation.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2102: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
